lastUserInput: In this repo, do these steps in order. Run each as its own shell command with your command-running tool (never your file tools, never two steps in one command), and do not ask me anything. 1. git checkout -b feature-live 2. echo feature > FEATURE.txt 3. git add FEATURE.txt 4. git commit -m 'a feature' 5. git push origin feature-live 6. gh pr list 7. ls. Then reply with just: done
